title: 第19章 直接认输黑幕第20章 冤家路窄废去修为
content_zh:
“既然你苏家想要退婚，那我便成全你，今日族比的最后，你我二人战上一场，你若能赢，我们两家之间的婚约作废。”
“不过你若输了...”
叶无尘话音还未落下，苏清雪淡漠的声音便直接响了起来：
“我若输了，我们二人的婚约依旧作数。”
听到苏清雪如此不要脸的话语，叶无尘一脸嫌恶的开口道：
“苏清雪，你不会真的认为自己很招人喜欢吧。”
紧接着，叶无尘继续开口道：
“你若输了，婚约依旧作废，只不过不是你苏清雪看不上我，而是我叶无尘，要休了你！”
叶无尘此话响彻在整个演武场之中。
此话一出，苏清雪的脸色变得十分难看了起来。
以她的美貌，以她的天赋，整个武安城还有几人比的上自己。
甚至就连京城的姜家都有意与她联姻，叶无尘却直言要休了自己？
不过她很快就冷静了下来，叶无尘一个废物，又如何能战胜的了自己。
想必只是为了维护那为数不多的面子罢了。
“好，我等着。”
此刻的苏清雪十分庆幸自己选择跟叶无尘解除婚约。
在她看来，现在的叶无尘就跟那些赌场之中的赌徒一般，做着那不切实际的发财梦。
同时，看台之上，诸多世家的高层也是抱着同样的想法看向叶无尘。
在他们看来，叶无尘根本不可能战胜苏清雪。
“叶家主，你这义子，还挺会做白日梦的。”

姜战一脸玩味的朝叶南天开口道。
“比不得你儿子，四年前跪在地上喊我家无尘爷爷的，好像就是你儿子吧。”
叶南天淡漠的开口道。
“你！”
姜战一脸愤怒的看向叶南天。
他刚想动手，却看到了一旁的秦仲一脸笑眯眯的看着自己。
姜战冷哼一声，不再多言。
见到苏清雪答应下来，叶无尘也是直接朝演武台走去。
演武台中央，包括叶无尘在内的众多叶家弟子皆是从叶苍手中抽取到一个竹签。
“终于要开始了吗？”
看台之上的诸多势力皆是一脸期待。
往年的叶家族比虽然也有看头，但显然没有今年的精彩。
叶无尘跟苏清雪，一人是四年前的绝世妖孽，一人是武安城新晋的天才少女。
他们两人之间的恩怨，在场的众人可谓是十分期待。
content_en:
"Since your Su family wants to break off the engagement, I will grant it to you. At the end of today's clan competition, you and I will have a battle. If you win, the engagement between our two families will be invalidated."
"But if you lose..."
Before Ye Wuchen finished speaking, Su Qingxue's indifferent voice rang out:
"If I lose, our engagement will still count."
Hearing Su Qingxue's shameless words, Ye Wuchen said with a look of disgust:
"Su Qingxue, you don't really think you are very popular, do you?"
Immediately afterwards, Ye Wuchen continued to speak:
"If you lose, the engagement will still be void, but it's not you, Su Qingxue, who despises me, but I, Ye Wuchen, want to divorce you!"
Ye Wuchen's words resounded throughout the entire martial arts arena.
As soon as these words came out, Su Qingxue's face became very ugly.
With her beauty and talent, there are several people in Wu'an City who can compare with her.
Even the Jiang family in the capital was interested in marrying her, but Ye Wuchen bluntly said that he wanted to divorce him?
But she quickly calmed down. How could Ye Wuchen, a loser, defeat herself?
It must be just to maintain the few face.
"Okay, I'll wait."
At this moment, Su Qingxue was very happy that she chose to terminate her engagement with Ye Wuchen.
In her opinion, Ye Wuchen now is just like those gamblers in casinos, dreaming of unrealistic dreams of getting rich.
At the same time, in the stands, the senior officials of many aristocratic families looked at Ye Wuchen with the same idea.
In their opinion, it was impossible for Ye Wuchen to defeat Su Qingxue.
"Master Ye, your adopted son is quite good at daydreaming."
Jiang Zhan said to Ye Nantian with a playful expression.
"I can't compare to your son. The one who knelt on the ground and called my grandpa Wuchen four years ago must have been your son."
Ye Nantian said indifferently.
"You!"
Jiang Zhan looked at Ye Nantian with an angry look.
Just as he was about to take action, he saw Qin Zhong looking at him with a smile on his face.
Jiang Zhan snorted coldly and said no more.
Seeing Su Qingxue agreeing, Ye Wuchen also walked directly towards the martial arts stage.
In the center of the martial arts stage, many Ye family disciples, including Ye Wuchen, drew a bamboo stick from Ye Cang's hand.
"Is it finally starting?"
Many forces in the stands looked forward to it.
Although the Ye Family Competition in previous years was also interesting, it was obviously not as exciting as this year.
Ye Wuchen and Su Qingxue, one was a peerless evildoer four years ago, and the other was a new genius girl in Wu'an City.
Everyone present was looking forward to the grudge between the two of them.
